svg.title: Architecture Diagram — Government AI Multi-Agent Assistant
svg.desc: Shows how Hermes Agent, DeerFlow 2, and PraisonAI interact with 4 agents and 2 tools
svg.text: Hermes Agent = Nous-Hermes-2-Mistral-7B powering all agents (self-critique + few-shot + meta-reasoning)
DeerFlow 2 = deerflow/replanner.py — dynamic workflow graph with conditional branching
PraisonAI = memory/praison_memory.py — cross-agent long-term + episodic memory
All models run locally via LM Studio · No external APIs · Quantized GGUF format
